title: Sorrowmurk
wikitext:
[[Image:Sorrowmurk.jpg|thumb|300px|Sorrowmurk]]
The '''Sorrowmurk''' is the area of the [[Swamp of Sorrows]] located just east of the [[Pool of Tears]] and the [[Sunken Temple]]. The area is crawling with green [[dragonspawn]] and travelers are warned that venturing into the area is extremely hazardous. As if this was not enough, there is also a large green [[drake]] that patrols the region.
